However, the provided data only includes revenue and gross margin percentages. To determine the profit, we would need information on the cost of goods sold (COGS) for each segment. 

The total consolidated revenue for Q1 2026 is $148.5M, and the total consolidated revenue for Q1 2025 was $130.0M, representing a 14.2% year-over-year growth [1]. The total consolidated gross margin percentage is 42.8% [1].
